session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trap, Then Midday Reversal Up'. Reading: buy climax at 6502.5 early on (07:30), the attempt above the blue 6490 dotted level trapped bulls and sold off in a bear wedge pencil-down to 6472 at 08:30, with an LH retest at 6483 extending the decline to a 6466 low; bar 41 midday reversal plus a higher-low double bottom at 10:35 flipped the day, and the afternoon built a small pullback bull trend under the red dotted 6483 resistance toward the 6490 blue line, closing ~6488. Morning-down/midday-reversal-up = trend_reversal_to_bull (title map agrees). Note axis: '8/13' left edge then 07:00-13:00 hours with 8/14 edge marker.

events.label: climax
events.outcome_reason: the day's top formed under the pink dotted line and the bull trap followed
events.evidence: pink 'Buy climax' text over the 07:25-07:35 6500 spike

events.label: failed_breakout
events.outcome_reason: breakout above the blue dotted 6490 level failed in the beige box and the morning sell-off began
events.evidence: beige boxed bars at 6490-6483 with consecutive sell arrows beneath the 'Bull Trap' title device

events.label: wedge
events.outcome_reason: pink dotted falling wedge into the 6472 lows produced the 6477-6480 bounce but the decline then extended to 6466
events.evidence: pink 'Wedge' text at 08:20 with magenta dotted wedge line into the 08:30 low

events.label: lower_high_double_top
events.outcome_reason: the LH retest at 6483 (beige box) failed and the trend resumed down
events.evidence: short red dotted line at 6483 from 08:05 to 09:00 with sell arrows

events.label: midday_reversal
events.outcome_reason: the low at 10:35 reversed the morning bear trend and the afternoon bull trend followed
events.evidence: blue 'Bar 41 midday reversal' text with blue arrow to the 10:35 low

events.label: higher_low_double_bottom
events.outcome_reason: HL DB at the day's low launched the afternoon small pullback bull trend
events.evidence: green 'Higher low double bottom' text with green dotted line under the 10:35-10:45 lows

events.label: l2
events.raw_label: red dotted resistance line sell signal
events.outcome_reason: first test of the long red dotted 6483 resistance failed as a sell; after the pullback the bull trend resumed past the line
events.evidence: long red dotted 6483 line with red sell arrows at 11:50 and 12:35 tops
